product_one_liner.value: Matillion is an intelligent data integration platform that helps data teams build and manage data pipelines faster for AI and analytics at scale.

pricing_page.notes: The company has a public pricing page describing its plans and consumption-based pricing.

named_customers.notes: The company says these enterprises trust Matillion.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists company size as 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: Matillion describes itself as dual-headquartered in Manchester, UK and Denver, Colorado.

founded_year.notes: The company homepage says it was founded in 2011.

eng_blog.notes: Alongside general blog content, Matillion has at least two technical build/project posts: one on engineering a pipeline-quality reviewer and one on an internal AI monitoring tool developed with its Developer Experience team; the latter is internship-project content, so this is a technical-post rather than a claim that the entire blog is engineering-only.

public_docs.notes: Public Maia and Matillion documentation sites contain multiple product guides.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers listings include AI Data Scientist and Senior Staff AI Engineer roles.

model_provider.value: AWS Bedrock, OpenAI's ChatGPT, and OpenAI for Azure
model_provider.notes: Matillion says it integrates with these third-party AI services to provide AI capabilities.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Center names SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, and PCI DSS.

last_funding.notes: The latest identified round is dated November 8, 2022; its amount is undisclosed, represented as 0 because the schema requires a numeric amount.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified funding round was Series E in November 2022, before the 18-month window ending November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The listed openings include Sales Development Representative and Senior Sales Development Representative roles.

launched_6mo.notes: Matillion announced general availability of Maia Foundation on Google BigQuery on July 8, 2026, within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: An August 4, 2026 announcement names Girish Pancha as CEO and Sanjay Krishnamurthi as Chief Development Officer.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These tools are named in Matillion SDR job descriptions as sales engagement, intelligence, or pipeline-management tools.
